info.title: GCMS Automation API
info.description: Automation API for enabled languages, media uploads, post categories, link categories, post and link draft previews, posts, pages, and links. Replace the server URL with GCMS_API_BASE for the target site.

get.summary: Discover live page modes, operations, scopes, limits, and safety protocols

200.description: Capability catalog; clients must check available and granted independently

get.summary: Discover existing page projects and their latest ETags

200.description: Matching page projects, page summaries, ETags and governance links

post.summary: Create a sidecar composition/app project for an existing standard page
post.description: Requires If-Match from the standard-page conversion plan and Idempotency-Key. Existing standard-page data remains unchanged.

get.summary: Read a page project and its working revision

200.description: Project envelope; ETag response header is required for the next write

post.summary: Create an immutable revision from base_revision_id

409.description: ETag/base revision/idempotency conflict; fetch and merge

404.description: Revision does not belong to this project

post.summary: Create a new working revision from immutable history

get.summary: Read the live Pilot page-design context
get.description: Returns the current site identity, Hero, theme inheritance defaults, navigation, component registry, real data sources, page recipes, workflow policy, and required preview sizes.

get.summary: List the component registry and property schemas
List live GCMS data sources and binding fields

post.summary: Preview a manifest or component binding against live data

200.description: Resolved preview data without writing a revision

post.summary: Upload a validated composition image using multipart/form-data
Upload a validated sandboxed app ZIP using multipart/form-data

422.description: Unsafe path, remote code, undeclared capability, or limit violation

get.summary: Read an editable private app text source

200.description: Text source from an immutable private bundle

put.summary: Replace an allow-listed text source and create a new revision

201.description: New immutable app revision after whole-bundle validation

422.description: Unsafe path, source, manifest, or capability declaration

get.summary: List declared, available, requested, and granted app capabilities

post.summary: Approve or deny a requested app capability
post.description: Approval accepts no password or approval token. The first request returns unlock_required/page_challenge bound to site/page/project/revision/capability/normalized config/decision/ETag/request-id/subject; Pilot native UI retries the byte-equivalent request with X-GCMS-Control-Unlock.

200.description: Capability decision recorded or idempotently replayed

409.description: Target conflict or Pilot-native unlock required

get.summary: Read an immutable build and its diagnostics

post.summary: Create a short-lived private preview for an exact revision/build
Validate and describe the exact publication impact

200.description: Impact, validation, revision and build identity

409.description: Revision/build conflict or build_stale after live bound data changed

post.description: Without native confirmation returns unlock_required and an opaque page_challenge. The backend password and internal approval token never enter the model context. The native token is bound to operation/site/page/project/revision/build/live-data snapshot/ETag/request-id/subject.

409.description: Target/build conflict, build_stale, or native confirmation required

post.summary: Validate and describe rollback to an exact historical revision

409.description: Revision/build conflict or build_stale after live bound data changed

post.description: The same native boundary as publication binds operation/site/page/project/revision/build/live-data snapshot/ETag/request-id/subject; the AI never receives the password or internal approval token.

409.description: Target/build conflict, build_stale, or native confirmation required

post.description: UI-only. Requires X-GCMS-Control-UI: pilot and the exact page_challenge for pages.publish, pages.rollback, or page_capabilities.grant. Never call this from the skill or ask the user for a password.

403.description: Not Pilot native UI or missing scope

409.description: Challenge expired, used, or target changed

get.summary: Read site profile and global Logo scale

patch.summary: Update site profile or global Logo scale
patch.description: logo_scale must be a top-level field, is shared by every language, accepts 0.3 through 2, and requires brand:assets:write.

CreatePosts.description: Creates content and returns its current strong ETag.

GetPosts.description: Returns the current strong ETag for a later conditional update.

UpdatePosts.description: If-Match remains optional for legacy compatibility. New clients should send the strong ETag from the latest read; a stale value returns revision_conflict instead of overwriting.

CreatePages.description: Creates a legacy standard page and returns its current strong ETag.

GetPages.description: Returns the current strong ETag for a later conditional update.

UpdatePages.description: If-Match remains optional for old-client compatibility. New clients should send the strong ETag from the latest read. Existing page projects return project_api_required; the bundled skill only edits legacy standard-page drafts and never publishes through this compatibility route.

409.description: If-Match is stale or the page is owned by a page project

CreateLinks.description: Creates content and returns its current strong ETag.

GetLinks.description: Returns the current strong ETag for a later conditional update.

UpdateLinks.description: If-Match remains optional for legacy compatibility. New clients should send the strong ETag from the latest read; a stale value returns revision_conflict instead of overwriting.

PageFilePath.name: file_path
PageFilePath.description: Percent-encoded package-relative path. Empty, absolute, dot, dot-dot, and backslash segments are forbidden.

PageIfMatch.name: If-Match
PageIfMatch.description: Exact ETag from the latest project response. Never guess or overwrite after a conflict.

PageIdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
PageIdempotencyKey.description: Stable only for byte-equivalent retries of one logical request.

PageControlUnlock.name: X-GCMS-Control-Unlock
PageControlUnlock.description: Short-lived target-bound credential injected only by Pilot native UI. The AI must never receive, print, or persist it.

ContentIfMatch.name: If-Match
ContentIfMatch.description: Strong ETag from the latest single-item read or write. New clients should send it; omission is retained only for legacy compatibility.

Lang.name: lang
Lang.description: Content language. Use all for cross-language queries.

ContentETag.description: Strong validator for the complete persisted content row.

preview_url.description: Current API preview endpoint URL. Requests still need the access key.

public_url.description: Front-end URL after publishing. Draft content may not be publicly accessible yet.

content_html.description: Rendered HTML from the Markdown body, useful for AI or external tools during pre-publish review.

logo_scale.description: Global front-end Logo display scale. 1 keeps the original display size.
Top-level global Logo display scale. Requires brand:assets:write; do not place it inside items.
